title: Session creation (host → service, §6.1) with host mode (AIT-78)
description: The host preallocates sid, creates the journal session and the authz record, mints tokens, then calls POST /v1/sessions with service authentication (mTLS or a service JWT). host_mode working_spec_only disables submission and acceptance; the session always ends with a handover export.

auto.description: Review mode only: submit confirmed versions at most every 5 min in addition to explicit submission and session end.

refines_note.description: Prose reference to a feature under discussion (e.g. a ticket key); never a formal relation in v1.
